author: Adam Conover
description:
Why does today's economy seem to exist for the pleasure of the rich at the expense of the young? Today I'm joined by Kyla Scanlon, one of the best economic educators in America. Kyla Scanlon does an incredible job following and explaining the bizarre state of the economy day by day on social media, and in writing. She has a new podcast on the Vox network called Best of Luck.

“Best of Luck” is a production of Vox. New episodes are released weekly on Tuesdays on Vox's YouTube channel, Apple Podcasts, Spotify, or wherever you get your podcasts. Follow on socials @bestofluckpodcast.
